title: B2C Mobile App Launch
description: Model the first 6 months of a mobile app launch across iOS and Android. Optimize CAC, retention, and monetization timing to reach sustainable growth before cash runs out.

decision.prompt: Choose your primary user acquisition and monetization strategy for launch.

options.label: Paid UA + freemium funnel
options.description: Invest heavily in Meta and TikTok ads to drive installs, then convert free users to paid over 7-14 days. Scalable but costly if CAC exceeds LTV.

options.label: Micro-influencer seeding
options.description: Allocate 60% of budget to micro-influencers (10k-200k followers) for authentic reach. Lower CAC but less predictable volume and harder to measure ROI.

options.label: ASO + organic-first
options.description: Invest in App Store Optimization and content marketing before paid spend. Slower ramp but builds a defensible organic moat and lower blended CAC.

launch_budget_usd.label: Launch Marketing Budget ($)
launch_budget_usd.description: Total budget for paid UA across Meta, TikTok, and ASA in the first 6 months.

target_cac_usd.label: Target CAC ($)
target_cac_usd.description: Cost per install you're willing to accept in month 1.

day30_retention.label: Day-30 Retention Target
day30_retention.description: Percentage of day-1 users still active at day 30 (e.g. 0.25 = 25%).

free_to_paid_conversion.label: Free-to-Paid Conversion Rate
free_to_paid_conversion.description: Percentage of free users who convert to paid within 30 days of hitting the paywall.

monthly_subscription_price_usd.label: Monthly Subscription Price ($)
monthly_subscription_price_usd.description: Price per month for the paid tier. Drives LTV and payback period calculations.

paywall_timing_days.label: Paywall Timing (Days After Install)
paywall_timing_days.description: When users first encounter the paywall or subscription prompt after installing.
